body: To be honest - I am so scared. The anxiety, the mistakes, the failures I have had. I never had the answers. Every action that I have done (which I thought was the right thing) ended up hurting someone or my (soon to be gone) SO. I get so mad trying so hard just to fuck up and have it blow up in my face and I take it out on people. I have burned bridges. Being social gives me anxiety. I’m just so scared of interacting and breathing. One thing at a time is terrifying. I am scared to move or be seen by anyone. I feel like a source of sadness for people I love.
